youtube_description:
Dr. Daveed Frazier, MD is a board certified, Harvard trained orthopedic spine surgeon, who specializes in surgical intervention for common sources of back pain. Dr. Frazier treats a wide range of spinal disorders, from degenerative disc disease to herniated discs, spinal stenosis, and sciatica. A master of minimally invasive spine surgery, Dr. Frazier brings his surgical skill and expertise to the communities of Morristown, NJ & Manhattan, NY.

For more information on minimally invasive spine surgery and common spinal disorders, please visit our website: www.newyorkcityspine.com
